interpretation: The final configuration retained strong segmentation performance on the locked test evaluation, with only a modest reduction relative to validation. ES remained more challenging than ED, showing lower mean Dice, greater variability, and more high-area-error cases. The final test predictions also showed a negative signed LV area bias, indicating a tendency toward under-segmentation. No post-test correction or additional tuning was performed.
historical_test_exposure_limitation: The 50-patient test partition had been inspected during earlier pilot development before the clean Phase 1 rebuild. It was not used during clean Phase 1A-1D model selection. Therefore these results represent the locked final evaluation of the clean pipeline, but are not claimed to constitute a pristine never-inspected external or independent test set.
decision: Accept the selected segmentation configuration and freeze it for downstream quantitative LV analysis.
